name: io.github.sheetrender/sheetrender-mcp
description: Render PDFs from templates and spreadsheet data via SheetRender, locally or at mcp.sheetrender.com

environmentVariables.description: SheetRender API key (sr_live_...), from sheetrender.com under Settings. Required by this local package, which exits without it; the hosted server at mcp.sheetrender.com works without a key
environmentVariables.name: SHEETRENDER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SheetRender API; defaults to https://sheetrender.com
environmentVariables.name: SHEETRENDER_API_URL

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer <SheetRender API key> (sr_live_..., from sheetrender.com under Settings) for the full tool set: your own templates, HTML templates, datasets and batch jobs. Without it the server offers three tools that fill SheetRender's built-in templates (certificate, letter, donation receipt, job offer letter), up to 25 rows per call and a monthly document limit per user
